title: Order-Consistent Latent Geometry for Reliable Short-Horizon Planning in World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.18570v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent planners often rank candidate action sequences by terminal Euclidean distance to a goal latent. Exact agreement with transition distance would make this score ideal, but is stronger than planning requires: along a transition-shortest rollout, the essential requirement is that latent distance does not reverse true transition progress. We show that this pathwise no-reversal requirement is precisely the classical self-approaching condition. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to identify self-approachingness as a planner-facing compatibility condition for terminal Euclidean latent planning and to connect its violation to an exact finite-horizon candidate-order reversal. Because visual world models predict discrete latent sequences, we analyze their polygonal interpolation. translated_title: 面向世界模型可靠短时程规划的序一致潜空间几何
translated_abstract: 潜在规划器通常依据候选动作序列到目标潜变量的终端欧氏距离进行排序。若该评分能与转移距离完全一致，那将是理想的，但这比规划实际所需的条件更强：沿着一条转移最短的轨迹，本质的要求是潜空间距离不会逆转真实的转移进展。我们证明，这种逐路径的“不逆转”要求恰好等价于经典的自趋近条件。据我们所知，我们是首个将自趋近性识别为终端欧氏潜空间规划的面向规划器兼容性条件，并将其违背与有限视距内精确的候选排序反转相联系的工作。鉴于视觉世界模型预测的是离散潜变量序列，我们分析了其多边形插值。我们证明，一个锐角弯折会产生一个非空区域，在该区域内，终端欧氏距离会将转移性能更差的候选排在转移进展更优的候选之前。（原文摘要至此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次将经典的自趋近条件识别为终端欧氏潜空间规划的面向规划器兼容性条件，证明了潜变量序列中的锐角弯折会导致有限视距内候选动作的排序反转，为世界模型的可靠短时程规划建立了潜空间几何设计准则。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first to identify the classical self-approaching condition as the planner-facing compatibility condition for terminal Euclidean latent planning, proving that acute bends in predicted latent sequences cause finite-horizon candidate-order reversals, thereby establishing latent-geometry principles for reliable short-horizon planning in world models.
